```{r}
#trying for a small dataset
data <- subset(data, period %in% c("Jan-Feb 2001", "Mar-Apr 2000"))

# Check for missing values in coordinates
sum(is.na(data$x))
sum(is.na(data$y))

# Filter out rows with missing coordinates
data <- data[!is.na(data$x) & !is.na(data$y), ]

# Convert 'period' to a factor variable
data$period <- as.factor(data$period)

# Check the structure again to confirm 'period' is now a factor
str(data)

# Specify the formula for the model
formula <- avg_LST ~ 1 + period

coords <- as.matrix(data[, c("x", "y")])  # Create matrix of coordinates

# Define priors for the GP model
priors <- spTimer::spT.priors(
  model = "GP",
  inv.var.prior = spTimer::Gamm(2, 2),
  beta.prior = spTimer::Norm(0, 10^2)
)

# Fit the hierarchical Bayesian model using spTimer
model <- spTimer::spT.Gibbs(
  formula = formula,
  data = data,
  coords=coords,  # Ensure these match your dataset
  model = "GP",  # Gaussian Process model
  priors = priors,  # Set priors
  nItr = 2,
  nBurn=1  # Number of iterations for Gibbs sampling
)


# Check model summary
summary(model)
```
